title: How do I check the party leader with variables?

posts.author: Powwhite
posts.body:
I need to make an area only passable if you have a specific character as the leader
i saw this guy doing it in this video but he didn't show it all (is at the right timestamp)

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
No, it's not at the right timestamp, it's one step too late.
here he checks which character ID is stored in the variable for the first member.
In your case you would allow passage if it is the correct number, and not for all other numbers.
The key is to fill the variable with the actor ID of the first member - which is not done here but earlier.
For more modern makers that is a default function of control variable in the game data section.
There should be something similar in control variable even for RM2K(3), but I never worked with them so I can't tell you where to look or how it is named.

posts.author: DevRPG2k
posts.body:
There is no option in the variables for this, the only game I saw that made it possible to check the leader was done entirely through simulation with events. There are 4 variables to store the positions of the time members and four more for when the player wants to reorder.
I remember he created this in Rm2k to have the option of having reserve members that could replace the main 4 for battle strategies.
The creator of this fangame probably used some PATCH, but the only ones we recommend are those made for version 1.12a (Steam), because they are released by EULA:
